description: Returns identity and transaction information about a confirmed block in the ledger.

parameters.name: slot_number
parameters.description: The slot number encoded as u64, 64-bit unsigned integer

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: The configuration object with the following fields:

sub_parameters.name: commitment
sub_parameters.description: The level of commitment required for the query. The options include:

sub_parameters.name: encoding
sub_parameters.description: (default: json) The encoding format for account data. It can be base58 (slow), base64, base64+zstd or jsonParsed

sub_parameters.name: transactionDetails
sub_parameters.description: (default: full) It specifies the level of transaction details to include in the response. The possible values are full, signatures, and none

sub_parameters.name: rewards
sub_parameters.description: (default: true) It determines whether to populate the rewards array or not.

sub_parameters.name: maxSupportedTransactionVersion
sub_parameters.description: The maximum transaction version to return in responses. If the requested block contains a transaction with a higher version, an error will be returned. If this parameter is omitted, only legacy transactions will be returned, and a block containing any versioned transaction will prompt an error

sub_parameters.name: legacy
sub_parameters.description: The older transaction format with no additional benefit
The additional support for Address Lookup Tables

result.description: Null if the specified block is not confirmed otherwise an object with the following fields:

result.blockhash.description: The hash of the confirmed block

result.previousBlockhash.description: The hash of the block's predecessor

result.parentSlot.description: The slot number of the block's parent

result.transactions.description: An array of transaction objects within the block. Each transaction object contains the following fields:

result.transactions.meta.description: The transaction status metadata object with the following fields:

result.transactions.meta.err.description: Error code if the transaction failed or null if the transaction succeeds

result.transactions.meta.innerInstructio.description: The list of inner instructions and it's omitted or null if inner instruction recording was not yet enabled during the transaction

result.transactions.meta.loadedAddresses.description: The list of loaded addresses objects
The ordered list of base-58 encoded addresses for readonly loaded accounts
The ordered list of base-58 encoded addresses for writable loaded accounts

result.transactions.meta.logMessages.description: An array of string log messages. Omitted or null if log message recording was not yet enabled during the transaction

result.transactions.meta.postBalances.description: An array of u64 account balances after the transaction was processed

result.transactions.meta.postTokenBalanc.description: The list of token balances from after the transaction was processed and it's omitted if inner instruction recording was not yet enabled during the transaction

result.transactions.meta.preBalances.description: An array of u64 account balances from before the transaction was processed

result.transactions.meta.preTokenBalance.description: The list of token balances from before the transaction was processed and it's omitted if inner instruction recording was not yet enabled during the transaction

result.transactions.meta.rewards.description: An array of reward objects detailing the rewards for this block. It is only present if rewards are requested; an array of JSON objects with the following fields:

result.transactions.meta.rewards.pubkey.description: The public key of the account receiving the reward

result.transactions.meta.rewards.postBal.description: The balance of the account after receiving the reward

result.transactions.meta.rewards.rewardT.description: The type of reward such as fee or stake

result.transactions.meta.rewards.comissi.description: The vote account commission when the reward was credited, only present for voting and staking rewards

result.transactions.meta.status.description: The processing status of the transaction. It returns Ok if the transaction was successful and Err if the transaction failed with TransactionError

result.transaction.description: The transaction object with the following fields:

result.transaction.message.description: The transaction message containing the following fields:

result.transaction.message.accountKeys.description: An array of public keys involved in the transaction

result.transaction.message.header.description: An object containing the transaction's header, including the following fields:

result.transaction.message.header.numReq.description: The number of required signatures for the transaction

result.transaction.message.header.numRea.description: The number of readonly accounts that have signed the transaction
The number of readonly accounts that have not signed the transaction

result.transaction.message.instructions.description: An array of instruction objects for the transaction with the following fields:

result.transaction.message.instructions..description: An array of integers representing the indices of accounts involved in the instruction
The instruction data encoded in the specified format
The index of the program ID in the accountKeys

result.recentBlockhash.description: The most recent blockhash used for the transaction

result.signatures.description: An array of signatures strings corresponding to the transaction order in the block
